purpose: Cross-domain acceptance index for the 120-layer procedural development plan.
cross_domain_invariants: Authoritative World State exists before observation.
Persistent entities never reroll after materialization.
Identity and current mutable state remain distinct.
Species, culture, citizenship, affiliation, organization, rank, position and personality remain distinct.
Knowledge and memory are actor-specific and distinct from World Truth.
Population materialization conserves real slots and totals unless a world event changes them.
Generated traffic, missions and crises have causal World State origins.
Visual assets consume authoritative state and preserve identity lineage.
AI cannot directly mutate World State or invent hidden truth.
Save/load, LOD and generator upgrades cannot silently regenerate persistent entities.
Campaign history outranks future screen canon after campaign start.

runtime_boundary.star_trek_repository_owns: content rules, universe-specific contracts, validation expectations, fixtures, visual/NAP rules and gameplay requirements
runtime_boundary.core_rpg_owns: generic live entity records, authoritative mutations, generic persistence, actions, simulation, deterministic runtime systems and reusable world-state semantics
runtime_boundary.ue5_or_host_owns: presentation, input, 3D scene/UI/audio and host integration

runtime_dependency_status.verified_state: Phase 4.4 closed; Generic World State 4.5 not yet implemented.
verified_evidence: CoreRPG README states WorldState is deliberately minimal and 4.5 begins Generic World State.
Current WorldState only creates monotonic EntityId values, tests membership/count/revision and lacks general live domain records.
No general DefinitionId-to-EntityId instantiation, gameplay persistence, knowledge, population or simulation exists yet.
runtime_dependency_status.effect: Star Trek-side design acceptance can close, but full executable vertical-slice/runtime acceptance remains blocked on CoreRPG.

release_gate_for_runtime: CoreRPG Generic World State supports persistent live records.
Definition/content definitions can instantiate persistent entities with provenance.
Generic deterministic state mutation/actions are available.
Persistence/save-load supports Star Trek identity round-trip requirements.
Simulation/event infrastructure can host the sensor operation/event-log fixture.
Star Trek content pack mapping to CoreRPG contracts is implemented and validated.
Host/UE5 can submit sensor action and render structured result without owning truth.
